region.description: The streams' AWS region. Default: the AWS default config's.

endpoint.description: A Kinesis-compatible endpoint: an emulator's, or a VPC endpoint.

accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key. Without one, the AWS default credentials.

schemaRegistryUrl.description: A Confluent-compatible schema registry. Avro and Protobuf need one.

format.description: How records' data is encoded. Avro and Protobuf register each stream's schema under <stream>-value.

namespace.description: Used when the pipeline names no namespace: streams are named namespace.table.

shards.description: Created streams are provisioned with this many shards. Unset: on-demand.
